articles.title: Software Technology Parks of India opens new incubation centre in Dehradun
articles.summary: Software Technology Parks of India opened a thirty thousand square foot incubation facility in Dehradun on twenty three October twenty twenty six. Union Minister Jitin Prasada inaugurated the centre to support startups and information technology businesses in Uttarakhand. The initiative aims to strengthen regional technology entrepreneurship and employment growth beyond established metropolitan hubs.

articles.title: Actor Naseeruddin Shah Backs Protesting Kolkata Film Institute Students
articles.summary: Actor Naseeruddin Shah criticized the Bharatiya Janata Party on Saturday for targeting Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute students in Kolkata. The students have staged an indefinite sit-in since October twelve following campus violence and administrative issues. Shah accused the political party of taking revenge on critics. The institute suspended academic operations and ordered students to leave the campus.

articles.summary: The assurance came after the Joint Action Committee of Stone Crushers Owners Association and Workers Association met Deputy Chief Minister Prestone Tynsong, who heads the government-constituted committee on quarrying on Friday. articles.title: UPSSSC implements strict anti-cheating measures for Premlinary Eligibility Test 2026
articles.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission is preparing for the upcoming Preliminary Eligibility Test scheduled for late October and early November. The District Magistrate, Manish Kumar Verma, announced that 48 exam centers will be established for the event. Students from various districts are expected to arrive at these centers during the exam dates.

articles.title: Trump again claims credit for halting India-Pak war at midterm poll rally; rues Nobel
articles.summary: Addressing the rally on Friday, Trump took credit for stopping India and Pakistan from escalating their military conflict last year, saying he threatened to impose steep tariffs on both countries if they continued fighting. He said the two nuclear-armed nations were angry but stopped shooting, adding that “eleven planes were shot down.”

articles.title: Goa Launches Konkani Language Model to Improve Artificial Intelligence Tools
articles.summary: Goa launched a Konkani Large Language Model at the Goa AI Tech Conclave 2026 in Panaji on October 22 and 23. Developed with the Digital India BHASHINI Division, the initiative aims to enhance artificial intelligence understanding of Konkani text and speech. Officials also demonstrated real-time speech translation and proposed a community pilot to build language resources for better digital access.

articles.title: India finishes fourth with record medal haul at Asian Para Games
articles.summary: India achieved its best-ever performance at the Asian Para Games by securing one hundred fourteen medals in Nagoya, Japan. The week-long continental competition concluded with a closing ceremony on Saturday. This historic finish places the country fourth overall in the final standings, marking a major milestone for the nation's athletes.

articles.summary: In the clip, the minister stood on stage beside the trophy, smiling and waving at the cameras. He then picked up the massive piece of silverware and appeared to walk away with it. articles.title: Jharkhand Pollution Control Board limits firecracker noise to 125 dB(A)
articles.summary: Firecrackers with a noise level below 125 dB(A) would be allowed to be sold in the state and burst within the allotted timings, the Jharkhand State Pollution Control Board (JSPCB) stated in a directive issued on Saturday. The move aims at curbing air and noise pollution during Diwali, Chhath, Christmas, and New Year celebrations.

articles.title: Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (2026): Expanding Micro-Enterprise
articles.summary: The Government of India continues the Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme to expand formal credit access and support micro-enterprises. Administered by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, the initiative provides credit-linked subsidies for new non-farm businesses. Since its inception in two thousand eight, the scheme has assisted hundreds of thousands of enterprises and generated substantial employment opportunities nationwide.

articles.title: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry urges increased Dutch investment
articles.summary: The Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry called for increased Dutch investment in manufacturing and technology sectors during a ministerial visit to the Netherlands. Officials emphasized joint ventures, supply chain integration, and technology partnerships to strengthen bilateral economic ties. This engagement aims to translate discussions into commercial projects ahead of a potential trade agreement.

articles.title: PUMA India Promotes Deven Deshpande to Lead Sports Marketing
articles.summary: Sportswear brand PUMA India has elevated Deven Deshpande to lead its sports marketing department in October 2026. Deshpande has worked with the company for over seven years, starting as a management trainee in 2019 and holding various roles across growth hacking and social media. His appointment aims to strengthen the brand's future marketing campaigns and sports partnerships across the country.

articles.title: Model And Designer Sahara Ray Passes Away At Age Thirty Four
articles.summary: Model and swimwear designer Sahara Ray has died at the age of thirty four at a hospital surrounded by loved ones. Her family confirmed the heartbreaking news to the media. Ray built a following through modelling and social media, and launched her own swimwear label. Her cause of death has not been officially confirmed by authorities yet.
articles.title_hi: मॉडल और डिजाइनर सहारा रे का चौंतीस साल की उम्र में निधन
articles.summary_hi: मॉडल और स्विमवीयर डिजाइनर सहारा रे का चौंतीस साल की उम्र में प्रियजनों के बीच एक अस्पताल में निधन हो गया। उनके परिवार ने मीडिया को दिल दहला देने वाली खबर की पुष्टि की। रे ने मॉडलिंग और सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम से अनुयायी बनाए और अपना खुद का स्विमवीयर लेबल लॉन्च किया। उनकी मौत के कारण की अधिकारियों द्वारा अभी तक आधिकारिक पुष्टि नहीं की गई है।
articles.title_hinglish: modala aura dijainara sahara re ka chauntisa sala ki umra men nidhana
articles.summary_hinglish: modala aura svimaviyara dijainara sahara re ka chauntisa sala ki umra men priyajanon ke bicha eka aspatala men nidhana ho gaya। unake parivara ne midiya ko dila dahala dene vali khabara ki pushti ki। re ne modalinga aura soshala midiya ke madhyama se anuyayi banae aura apana khuda ka svimaviyara lebala loncha kiya। unaki mauta ke karana ki adhikariyon dvara abhi taka aadhikarika pushti nahin ki gaee hai।

articles.title: Tilak Varma leads India to thrilling Twenty20 victory over New Zealand
articles.summary: India defeated New Zealand by four wickets in the second Twenty20 international on Saturday after vice-captain Tilak Varma scored an unbeaten fifty. Varma credited head coach Gautam Gambhir and batting coach Sitanshu Kotak for inspiring his match-winning performance. The victory gives India a two-nil lead in the five-match series following a brilliant late partnership with Nitish Kumar Reddy.

articles.title: Harihara Arun Somasankar G Appointed Standing Counsel of the Bar Council of Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: No. 1473/2026, the Council informed him that, as directed by its Chairman, he had been appointed Standing Counsel to conduct cases on behalf of the Bar Council before the Honble High Court of Madras. The letter was issued under the signature of Greetha Senthilkumar, Secretary of the Bar Council, and confirms that the appointment took effect on 18 September 2026.
articles.title_hi: हरिहर अरुण सोमशंकर जी को बार काउंसिल ऑफ तमिलनाडु का स्थायी वकील नियुक्त किया गया
articles.summary_hi: संख्या 1473/2026, परिषद ने उन्हें सूचित किया कि, उसके अध्यक्ष के निर्देशानुसार, उन्हें मद्रास के माननीय उच्च न्यायालय के समक्ष बार काउंसिल की ओर से मामलों का संचालन करने के लिए स्थायी वकील नियुक्त किया गया था। पत्र बार काउंसिल के सचिव ग्रीथा सेंथिलकुमार के हस्ताक्षर के तहत जारी किया गया था और पुष्टि करता है कि नियुक्ति 18 सितंबर 2026 को प्रभावी हुई थी।
articles.title_hinglish: harihara aruna somashankara ji ko bara kaunsila ऑpha tamilanadu ka sthayi vakila niyukta kiya gaya
articles.summary_hinglish: sankhya 1473/2026, parishada ne unhen suchita kiya ki, usake adhyaksha ke nirdeshanusar, unhen madrasa ke mananiya uchcha nyayalaya ke samaksha bara kaunsila ki ora se mamalon ka sanchalana karane ke lie sthayi vakila niyukta kiya gaya tha। patra bara kaunsila ke sachiva gritha senthilakumara ke hastakshara ke tahata jari kiya gaya tha aura pushti karata hai ki niyukti 18 sitanbara 2026 ko prabhavi huee thi।

articles.title: Indian Stock Markets Surge Following Finance Minister Tax Comments
articles.summary: Indian stock markets rebounded sharply on Tuesday in Mumbai as the benchmark Sensex gained over eleven hundred points. Investors welcomed Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman expressing willingness to discuss changes to key market taxes. Technology stocks led the recovery while analysts noted that holding critical support levels will be essential to sustain market momentum.

articles.title: Protests Erupt in India Over Electoral Register Overhaul and Voting Rights
articles.summary: Thousands of protesters took to the streets in Delhi and other Indian cities during October to oppose a national electoral register overhaul. Led by youth groups and opposition parties, demonstrators claimed the process disenfranchised millions of voters. Protesters demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, arguing the changes unfairly favored Prime Minister Narendra Modi and threatened Indian democracy.
articles.title_hi: भारत में चुनावी रजिस्टर में बदलाव और मतदान के अधिकार को लेकर विरोध प्रदर्शन शुरू हो गए हैं
articles.summary_hi: राष्ट्रीय चुनावी रजिस्टर में बदलाव का विरोध करने के लिए अक्टूबर के दौरान हजारों प्रदर्शनकारी दिल्ली और अन्य भारतीय शहरों में सड़कों पर उतर आए। युवा समूहों और विपक्षी दलों के नेतृत्व में, प्रदर्शनकारियों ने दावा किया कि इस प्रक्रिया ने लाखों मतदाताओं को मताधिकार से वंचित कर दिया है। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग करते हुए तर्क दिया कि ये बदलाव प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के पक्ष में नहीं हैं और इससे भारतीय लोकतंत्र को खतरा है।
articles.title_hinglish: bharata men chunavi rajistara men badalava aura matadana ke adhikara ko lekara virodha pradarshana shuru ho gae hain
articles.summary_hinglish: rashtriya chunavi rajistara men badalava ka virodha karane ke lie aktubara ke daurana hajaron pradarshanakari dilli aura anya bharatiya shaharon men sadakon para utara aae। yuva samuhon aura vipakshi dalon ke netritva men, pradarshanakariyon ne dava kiya ki isa prakriya ne lakhon matadataon ko matadhikara se vanchita kara diya hai। pradarshanakariyon ne mukhya chunava aayukta jnyanesha kumara ke istiphe ki manga karate hue tarka diya ki ye badalava pradhanamantri narendra modi ke paksha men nahin hain aura isase bharatiya lokatantra ko khatara hai।

articles.title: Tilak Varma and Nitish Reddy Secure Four-Wicket Victory in Christchurch
articles.summary: Tilak Varma scored an unbeaten fifty to lead India to a four-wicket victory against New Zealand in Christchurch. India successfully chased the target with one ball remaining after an unbroken seventh-wicket partnership with Nitish Kumar Reddy. The win gives India another successful run chase under pressure, adding to Tilak's growing reputation for finishing tight limited-overs matches.

articles.title: 8th All India Conference of GRP chiefs concludes in New Delhi, focus on intelligence-led
articles.summary: they will thank you later 8th All India Conference of GRP chiefs concludes in New Delhi, focus on intelligence-led policing to strengthen railway security --- Photo/PIB New Delhi, Oct 24: The 8th All India Conference of Government Railway Police (GRP) Chiefs, convened by the Railway Protection Force (RPF), concluded successfully in New Delhi on 23 October 2026.

articles.title: ‘No hesitation in detaining youth’: Congress targets government over US national VanDyke’s
articles.summary: Congress on Saturday questioned the decision to allow US national Matthew VanDyke, an accused in the Myanmar arms training case, to return to his home country, asking why a foreign national accused of terrorism was being granted such liberty while young activists protesting against alleged “vote chori” were being detained.

articles.title: Indian gangsters Himanshu Bhau and Neeraj Faridpuria detained in Las Vegas
articles.summary: United States immigration officers arrested wanted Indian gangsters Himanshu Bhau and Neeraj Faridpuria in Las Vegas on October twenty second following intelligence from the Haryana Special Task Force. Both men face numerous criminal charges including murder and extortion. Security agencies are currently working to secure their deportation to India to solve pending homicide cases.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय गैंगस्टर हिमांशु भाऊ और नीरज फरीदपुरिया को लास वेगास में हिरासत में लिया गया
articles.summary_hi: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के आव्रजन अधिकारियों ने हरियाणा स्पेशल टास्क फोर्स की खुफिया जानकारी के बाद 22 अक्टूबर को लास वेगास में वांछित भारतीय गैंगस्टर हिमांशु भाऊ और नीरज फरीदपुरिया को गिरफ्तार किया। दोनों व्यक्तियों पर हत्या और जबरन वसूली सहित कई आपराधिक आरोप हैं। सुरक्षा एजेंसियां ​​वर्तमान में लंबित मानव वध के मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए उनके भारत निर्वासन को सुरक्षित करने के लिए काम कर रही हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: bharatiya gaingastara himanshu bhaoo aura niraja pharidapuriya ko lasa vegasa men hirasata men liya gaya

articles.title: West Bengal | Shadows fall on a festival
articles.summary: But a sudden downpour, apparent fears that the pandal would fall, a narrow exit that doubled up as entrance, and a “chicken’s neck alley” outside—all the sequential makers of a tragedy came together at Chorebagan in north Kolkata. Or so says one plausible reconstruction. Only one thing is certain: Kolkata had never seen anything like it before.

articles.title: Ray of hope for drought-hit Telangana as low pressure over Bay of Bengal likely
articles.summary: The IMD has issued a red alert for Mulugu, Bhadradri Kothagudem and Khammam districts, forecasting heavy to very heavy rainfall, with isolated extremely heavy rainfall likely. For Hyderabad, the current forecast indicates moderate rainfall. Speaking to The Hindu , Srinivas GNRS, senior meteorologist at the IMD Centre Hyderabad, said the projected crossing point of the system had shifted southwards.
articles.title_hi: सूखा प्रभावित तेलंगाना के लिए आशा की किरण, बंगाल की खाड़ी पर कम दबाव की संभावना
articles.summary_hi: आईएमडी ने मुलुगु, भद्राद्री कोठागुडेम और खम्मम जिलों के लिए रेड अलर्ट जारी किया है, जिसमें भारी से बहुत भारी वर्षा की भविष्यवाणी की गई है, साथ ही अलग-अलग स्थानों पर अत्यधिक भारी वर्षा होने की संभावना है। हैदराबाद के लिए, वर्तमान पूर्वानुमान मध्यम वर्षा का संकेत देता है। द हिंदू से बात करते हुए, आईएमडी सेंटर हैदराबाद के वरिष्ठ मौसम विज्ञानी श्रीनिवास जीएनआरएस ने कहा कि सिस्टम का अनुमानित क्रॉसिंग पॉइंट दक्षिण की ओर स्थानांतरित हो गया है।

articles.summary_hinglish: aaeeemadi ne mulugu, bhadradri kothagudema aura khammama jilon ke lie reda alarta jari kiya hai, jisamen bhari se bahuta bhari varsha ki bhavishyavani ki gaee hai, satha hi alaga-alaga sthanon para atyadhika bhari varsha hone ki sanbhavana hai। haidarabada ke lie, vartamana purvanumana madhyama varsha ka sanketa deta hai। da hindu se bata karate hue, aaeeemadi sentara haidarabada ke varishtha mausama vijnyani shrinivasa jienaaaraesa ne kaha ki sistama ka anumanita krosinga pointa dakshina ki ora sthanantarita ho gaya hai।

articles.title: Amit Shah At Delhi Police HQ | High-Level Meeting On Law & Order, Security
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah visits Delhi Police Headquarters for a high-level meeting with senior police officials to review law and order and security in the national capital. The meeting is expected to focus on strengthening policing, counter-intelligence efforts, drug networks, gangster activity, crimes against women and the handling of recent protests in Delhi.

articles.title: Navi Mumbai airport adds nine domestic destinations to expand regional connectivity
articles.summary: Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) has added nine domestic destinations to its network, connecting the Mumbai Metropolitan Region with markets across Rajasthan, Bihar, Assam, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Lakshadweep and coastal Maharashtra. The expansion aims to improve regional access, support tourism and strengthen links with heritage, wildlife, island and eco-tourism destinations.
articles.title_hi: नवी मुंबई हवाई अड्डा क्षेत्रीय कनेक्टिविटी का विस्तार करने के लिए नौ घरेलू गंतव्य जोड़ता है

articles.title: 13 Years Of Assam Politics: From Congress Rule To BJP’s Continued Dominance
articles.summary: Projected to be a smart city by 2025, Guwahati is a major port on the banks of Brahmaputra, the capital of Assam and the urban hub of the North East. This metropolitan city is growing leaps and bounds, and for its unparalleled pace of growth, comes the need for an unparalleled publication, that people call their ‘own’.

articles.title: Why such liberty extended to terrorism accused: Congress after release of US national
articles.summary: The Congress on Saturday questioned the release of US national Matthew VanDyke, an accused in the Myanmar arms training case, and asked why such liberty was being extended to a foreign national accused of terrorism. Advertisement Congress general secretary, communications, Jairam Ramesh, said this is being done even when the government is arresting youth peacefully protesting against "vote chori".

articles.title: STPI Inaugurates New Incubation Facility in Dehradun to Boost Uttarakhand’s Startup
articles.summary: STPI Inaugurates New Incubation Facility in Dehradun to Boost Uttarakhand’s Startup Ecosystem Dehradun, October 24 (APAC Media): Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) has inaugurated a new incubation facility at IT Park, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand. The facility aims to strengthen the state’s IT and IT-enabled services (ITeS) ecosystem by providing modern infrastructure and support to technology companies and startups.

India is already a major manufacturing base for smartphones sold by international companies.

articles.title: KL Rahul, Dhruv Jurel fail as India A get bundled out for 113
articles.summary: India A suffered a batting meltdown in their unofficial Test against New Zealand A, getting bowled out for just 113 in 39. 3 overs as Simon Keene claimed five wickets on a grass-covered pitch. articles.title: Bihar MLC Polls Hit by Midnight Police Row as Tejashwi Yadav Alleges Misuse
articles.summary: Tejashwi alleged that government machinery was being used to trouble opposition candidates and interfere with the election process. articles.title: A snake last recorded in Gujarat’s Kutch in 1872 has been spotted again
articles.summary: A routine evening patrol in Kutch has turned into one of the more unexpected wildlife stories of the year. According to the Gujarat Forest Department and reports by India Today, forest officers near Bhuj stumbled on a slim, fast-moving snake that hadn’t been conclusively recorded in the region for over 150 years.

articles.title: Gunmen open fire at church during funeral in Jordan, killing 7, injuring 40
articles.summary: Jordan declared three days of national mourning, according to the kingdom's Petra News Agency | Photo: ANI Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Jordan on Friday, killing seven people and wounding 40 others, authorities said. articles.title: India Introduces National Anti Doping Amendment Act to Strengthen Sports Fairness
articles.summary: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports introduced the National Anti Doping Amendment Act to strengthen India's anti doping framework. The legislation improves the operational independence of the National Anti Doping Agency and aligns rules with international standards. India aims to protect clean athletes and address high violation rates recorded in recent years.

articles.title: India Highlights Nuclear Advances And Partnerships At United Nations
articles.summary: India reaffirmed its commitment to peaceful nuclear technology at the eighty-first session of the United Nations General Assembly. The nation highlighted the vital role of the International Atomic Energy Agency in promoting sustainable global development and strengthening institutional capabilities. This address emphasized India's dedication to safe scientific advancements and international cooperation for a better future.

articles.title: Young artists unite for the India Malaysia International Cultural Festival 2026
articles.summary: Young artists from India, Malaysia and Indonesia gathered at the India-Malaysia International Cultural Festival 2026 to promote cultural exchange through music, dance and visual arts. articles.summary: Amir Shokeen, the Delhi-based content creator apprehended for hurling racial abuse at a Tripura youth, was remanded to one-day judicial custody in a case registered at Sadar Bazar Police Station. articles.title: Indian Union Muslim League Promises Action Over Doha Office Heist

articles.summary: New Delhi: The Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) and Bank of India (BOI) have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to explore indigenous quantum technologies and other emerging technologies for banking and financial services. The MoU, signed on October 22, establishes a framework for joint research and development, pilot projects, proof-of-concept initiatives, technology demonstrations and capacity-building programmes.

articles.title: Indian Para Athletes Achieve Record Haul at Asian Para Games

articles.title: Reserve Bank of India Tightens Operational Risk Capital Norms for Banks
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has revised operational risk capital norms for banks. The new rules cover income classification, derivative valuations, and historical loss data. They become effective on April 1, 2027. Under the financial component, banks must separately classify gains and losses from trading book and banking book activities in line with regulatory directions.

articles.title_hinglish: isa saptahanta (24-25 aktubara) 5 dakshina bharatiya otiti rilij: da pairadaij, dorothi tu dhumakethu
articles.summary_hinglish: saptahanta aa gaya hai aura striminga katara pahale se hi bhari huee hai। isa saptaha ki dakshina bharatiya otiti rilija (24-25 aktubara) netaphliks, aha aura jiyohotastara se aaee hain, aura inamen telugu, tamila aura malayalama shamila hain। nani piriyada ekshana drama da pairadaija ka netritva karate hain, jabaki kirti suresha 1980 ke dashaka ke aparadha drama dorothi men abhinaya karati hain।

articles.title: Google Play Arena registrations open: Games, dates and MS Dhoni’s Mahi Clutchers
articles.summary: Google and NODWIN Gaming have announced Google Play Arena, a new mobile gaming championship featuring popular titles such as BGMI, Free Fire MAX, Mobile Legends, Real Cricket, Chess. com and EA SPORTS FC Mobile. Former Indian cricket captain MS Dhoni will participate through his esports club, Mahi Clutchers, which will recruit players through open qualifiers.
articles.title_hi: Google Play Arena पंजीकरण खुले: खेल, तिथियां और एमएस धोनी के माही क्लचर्स
articles.summary_hi: Google और NODWIN गेमिंग ने Google Play Arena की घोषणा की है, जो एक नई मोबाइल गेमिंग चैंपियनशिप है जिसमें BGMI, Free Fire MAX, मोबाइल लीजेंड्स, रियल क्रिकेट, शतरंज जैसे लोकप्रिय शीर्षक शामिल हैं। कॉम और ईए स्पोर्ट्स एफसी मोबाइल। पूर्व भारतीय क्रिकेट कप्तान एमएस धोनी अपने ईस्पोर्ट्स क्लब, माही क्लचर्स के माध्यम से भाग लेंगे, जो ओपन क्वालीफायर के माध्यम से खिलाड़ियों की भर्ती करेगा।
articles.title_hinglish: Google Play Arena panjikarana khule: khel, tithiyan aura emaesa dhoni ke mahi klacharsa
articles.summary_hinglish: Google aura NODWIN geminga ne Google Play Arena ki ghoshana ki hai, jo eka naee mobaila geminga chainpiyanashipa hai jisamen BGMI, Free Fire MAX, mobaila lijends, riyala kriket, shataranja jaise lokapriya shirshaka shamila hain। koma aura eee sportsa ephasi mobaila। purva bharatiya kriketa kaptana emaesa dhoni apane eesportsa klab, mahi klacharsa ke madhyama se bhaga lenge, jo opana kvaliphayara ke madhyama se khiladaिyon ki bharti karega।

articles.title: RSS-affiliate SJM urges Centre to deny Starlink licence on security grounds
articles.summary: In a memorandum submitted to Prime Minister Narendra Modi following a demonstration against Starlink at the Teen Murti Chowk in New Delhi, the RSS-affiliated organisation said the company's use of laser-based satellite links to transmit data directly between satellites raises concerns about Indian internet traffic bypassing domestic gateways during security-related emergencies.

articles.title: Forbes India highlights reliable brands driving growth across diverse industries
articles.summary: Forbes India has highlighted notable companies driving national economic growth through excellence and innovation across various sectors. The special feature showcases businesses like Krsnaa Diagnostics and WoodenStreet that combine trust, quality, and forward-thinking strategies to transform customer experiences and build sustainable opportunities. These established and emerging organizations continue to strengthen industries through their commitment to long-term impact.
articles.title_hi: फोर्ब्स इंडिया विभिन्न उद्योगों में विकास को बढ़ावा देने वाले विश्वसनीय ब्रांडों पर प्रकाश डालता है
articles.summary_hi: फोर्ब्स इंडिया ने विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में उत्कृष्टता और नवाचार के माध्यम से राष्ट्रीय आर्थिक विकास को बढ़ावा देने वाली उल्लेखनीय कंपनियों को उजागर किया है। विशेष फीचर कृष्णा डायग्नोस्टिक्स और वुडेनस्ट्रीट जैसे व्यवसायों को प्रदर्शित करता है जो ग्राहकों के अनुभवों को बदलने और स्थायी अवसरों का निर्माण करने के लिए विश्वास, गुणवत्ता और दूरदर्शी रणनीतियों को जोड़ते हैं। ये स्थापित और उभरते संगठन दीर्घकालिक प्रभाव के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता के माध्यम से उद्योगों को मजबूत करना जारी रखते हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: phorbsa indiya vibhinna udyogon men vikasa ko badhaाva dene vale vishvasaniya brandon para prakasha dalata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: phorbsa indiya ne vibhinna kshetron men utkrishtata aura navachara ke madhyama se rashtriya aarthika vikasa ko badhaाva dene vali ullekhaniya kanpaniyon ko ujagara kiya hai। vishesha phichara krishna dayagnostiksa aura vudenastrita jaise vyavasayon ko pradarshita karata hai jo grahakon ke anubhavon ko badalane aura sthayi avasaron ka nirmana karane ke lie vishvas, gunavatta aura duradarshi rananitiyon ko jodate hain। ye sthapita aura ubharate sangathana dirghakalika prabhava ke prati apani pratibaddhata ke madhyama se udyogon ko majabuta karana jari rakhate hain।

articles.title_hi: बिट्टू के लिए सब कुछ ख़त्म नहीं हुआ है, क्योंकि एमपी जिला प्रशासन ने नदी की सफ़ाई में सहयोग का आश्वासन दिया है
articles.summary_hi: यदि आप बाहर निकलना चाहते हैं, तो कृपया इस पृष्ठ के पाद लेख में "मेरी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी न बेचें या साझा न करें" लिंक पर क्लिक करें। हम आपके द्वारा देखे जाने वाले विज्ञापनों को सूचित करने के लिए आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी को बेचेंगे या साझा नहीं करेंगे। यदि आपकी जानकारी अन्य कंपनियों द्वारा बेची या साझा की जाती है या पहले बेची या साझा की गई थी, तब भी आपको रुचि-आधारित विज्ञापन दिखाई दे सकते हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: bittu ke lie saba kuchha khatma nahin huaa hai, kyonki emapi jila prashasana ne nadi ki saphaाee men sahayoga ka aashvasana diya hai
articles.summary_hinglish: yadi aapa bahara nikalana chahate hain, to kripaya isa prishtha ke pada lekha men "meri vyaktigata janakari na bechen ya sajha na karen" linka para klika karen। hama aapake dvara dekhe jane vale vijnyapanon ko suchita karane ke lie aapaki vyaktigata janakari ko bechenge ya sajha nahin karenge। yadi aapaki janakari anya kanpaniyon dvara bechi ya sajha ki jati hai ya pahale bechi ya sajha ki gaee thi, taba bhi aapako ruchi-aadharita vijnyapana dikhaee de sakate hain।

articles.title: India rewrite Asian Para Games record, but not every sport keeps pace
articles.summary: India finished the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya with a record 114 medals, surpassing the country's previous best at the continental event. The final tally of 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals bettered India's 2023 performance in Hangzhou, when the contingent officially finished with 108 medals after three medals were later stripped following doping violations.
articles.title_hi: भारत ने एशियाई पैरा खेलों का रिकॉर्ड फिर से लिखा, लेकिन हर खेल गति बनाए नहीं रखता
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने आइची-नागोया में 2026 एशियाई पैरा खेलों को रिकॉर्ड 114 पदकों के साथ समाप्त किया, जो महाद्वीपीय आयोजन में देश के पिछले सर्वश्रेष्ठ से आगे निकल गया। 30 स्वर्ण, 35 रजत और 49 कांस्य पदकों की अंतिम तालिका ने हांग्जो में भारत के 2023 के प्रदर्शन को बेहतर बना दिया, जब डोपिंग उल्लंघन के बाद तीन पदक छीन लिए जाने के बाद दल आधिकारिक तौर पर 108 पदकों के साथ समाप्त हुआ।
articles.title_hinglish: bharata ne eshiyaee paira khelon ka rikorda phira se likh, lekina hara khela gati banae nahin rakhata
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ne aaichi-nagoya men 2026 eshiyaee paira khelon ko rikorda 114 padakon ke satha samapta kiy, jo mahadvipiya aayojana men desha ke pichhale sarvashreshtha se aage nikala gaya। 30 svarn, 35 rajata aura 49 kansya padakon ki antima talika ne hangjo men bharata ke 2023 ke pradarshana ko behatara bana diy, jaba dopinga ullanghana ke bada tina padaka chhina lie jane ke bada dala aadhikarika taura para 108 padakon ke satha samapta huaa।

articles.title: 10th Military Literature Festival: 3-day event to be held in Chandigarh from Nov 13-15
articles.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann will preside over the closing ceremony. Group Captain Shubanshu Shukla, the first Indian astronaut to stay aboard the International Space Station, will deliver a talk titled “From Fighter Cockpit to Space Craft: India’s New Frontier in Air and Space Power”. A special session on space warfare has also been scheduled.
articles.title_hi: 10वां सैन्य साहित्य महोत्सव: 13-15 नवंबर तक चंडीगढ़ में 3 दिवसीय कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया जाएगा
articles.summary_hi: समापन समारोह की अध्यक्षता पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान करेंगे। ग्रुप कैप्टन शुभांशु शुक्ला, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन पर रहने वाले पहले भारतीय अंतरिक्ष यात्री, "फाइटर कॉकपिट से स्पेस क्राफ्ट तक: भारत की वायु और अंतरिक्ष शक्ति में नई सीमा" शीर्षक पर एक व्याख्यान देंगे। अंतरिक्ष युद्ध पर एक विशेष सत्र भी निर्धारित किया गया है।
articles.title_hinglish: 10van sainya sahitya mahotsav: 13-15 navanbara taka chandigadha men 3 divasiya karyakrama aayojita kiya jaega
articles.summary_hinglish: samapana samaroha ki adhyakshata panjaba ke mukhyamantri bhagavanta mana karenge। grupa kaiptana shubhanshu shukl, antarrashtriya antariksha steshana para rahane vale pahale bharatiya antariksha yatri, "phaitara kokapita se spesa kraphta tak: bharata ki vayu aura antariksha shakti men naee sima" shirshaka para eka vyakhyana denge। antariksha yuddha para eka vishesha satra bhi nirdharita kiya gaya hai।

articles.title: Major Indian companies announce series of chief financial officer leadership changes

articles.title_hi: प्रमुख भारतीय कंपनियों ने मुख्य वित्तीय अधिकारी के नेतृत्व में बदलाव की श्रृंखला की घोषणा की
articles.summary_hi: एबीबी इंडिया, फ्रैक्टल एनालिटिक्स और महिंद्रा मैनुलाइफ सहित कई प्रमुख भारतीय कंपनियों ने हाल ही में प्रमुख मुख्य वित्तीय अधिकारी नियुक्तियों की घोषणा की है। ये नेतृत्व परिवर्तन देश भर में विकसित हो रहे कॉर्पोरेट वित्त परिदृश्य को उजागर करते हैं। उद्योग विशेषज्ञ कॉर्पोरेट क्षेत्र के भीतर उभरती व्यावसायिक रणनीतियों और वित्तीय रुझानों के बारे में जानकारी हासिल करने के लिए इन कार्यकारी गतिविधियों की निगरानी करना जारी रखते हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: pramukha bharatiya kanpaniyon ne mukhya vittiya adhikari ke netritva men badalava ki shrrinkhala ki ghoshana ki
articles.summary_hinglish: ebibi indiy, phraiktala enalitiksa aura mahindra mainulaipha sahita kaee pramukha bharatiya kanpaniyon ne hala hi men pramukha mukhya vittiya adhikari niyuktiyon ki ghoshana ki hai। ye netritva parivartana desha bhara men vikasita ho rahe korporeta vitta paridrishya ko ujagara karate hain। udyoga visheshajnya korporeta kshetra ke bhitara ubharati vyavasayika rananitiyon aura vittiya rujhanon ke bare men janakari hasila karane ke lie ina karyakari gatividhiyon ki nigarani karana jari rakhate hain।

articles.title: Goa rationalises aviation turbine fuel VAT to 7% from October 24, IndiGo welcomes move
articles.summary: Goa government has announced a reduction in the value-added tax on aviation turbine fuel to 7%. This revised VAT rate will come into effect on October 24, 2026. IndiGo welcomed this decision, encouraging other states to implement similar measures. The airline believes this change will enhance air travel accessibility and boost the tourism sector in Goa.
articles.title_hi: गोवा ने 24 अक्टूबर से विमानन टरबाइन ईंधन वैट को तर्कसंगत बनाकर 7% कर दिया, इंडिगो ने इस कदम का स्वागत किया
articles.summary_hi: गोवा सरकार ने विमानन टरबाइन ईंधन पर मूल्यवर्धित कर को घटाकर 7% करने की घोषणा की है। यह संशोधित वैट दर 24 अक्टूबर, 2026 को लागू होगी। इंडिगो ने इस निर्णय का स्वागत किया, अन्य राज्यों को भी इसी तरह के उपाय लागू करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया। एयरलाइन का मानना ​​है कि इस बदलाव से हवाई यात्रा की पहुंच बढ़ेगी और गोवा में पर्यटन क्षेत्र को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।
articles.title_hinglish: gova ne 24 aktubara se vimanana tarabaina eendhana vaita ko tarkasangata banakara 7% kara diy, indigo ne isa kadama ka svagata kiya
articles.summary_hinglish: gova sarakara ne vimanana tarabaina eendhana para mulyavardhita kara ko ghatakara 7% karane ki ghoshana ki hai। yaha sanshodhita vaita dara 24 aktubar, 2026 ko lagu hogi। indigo ne isa nirnaya ka svagata kiy, anya rajyon ko bhi isi taraha ke upaya lagu karane ke lie protsahita kiya। eyaralaina ka manana ​​hai ki isa badalava se havaee yatra ki pahuncha badhaेgi aura gova men paryatana kshetra ko badhaाva milega।

articles.title: Mohanlal fans react to Vijay's 'I'm the Complete Actor' quip on KWK
articles.summary: Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s appearance on Koffee With Karan has sparked an online debate after their reaction to learning that Malayalam superstar Mohanlal is popularly known as the ‘Complete Actor’. articles.title_hi: मोहनलाल के प्रशंसकों ने KWK पर विजय की 'मैं संपूर्ण अभिनेता हूं' वाली चुटकी पर प्रतिक्रिया व्यक्त की

articles.title_hinglish: mohanalala ke prashansakon ne KWK para vijaya ki 'main sanpurna abhineta hun' vali chutaki para pratikriya vyakta ki
articles.summary_hinglish: kophaी vida karana men abhineta vijaya devarakonda aura rashmika mandana ki upasthiti ne yaha janane ke bada ki malayalama suparastara mohanalala ko 'sanpurna abhineta' ke rupa men jana jata hai, unaki pratikriya ke bada eka ऑnalaina bahasa chheda di hai। shirshaka para yugala ke spashta aashcharya ne mohanalala ke prashansakon ka dhyana aakarshita kiya hai, kuchha logon ne anubhavi abhineta se judaे upanama ke satha unaki aparichitata para savala uthaya hai।

articles.title: President Murmu delegates Dental commission act powers to UT administrators
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: President Droupadi Murmu has delegated powers to the Lieutenant Governors and administrators of all Union Territories (UTs) to exercise specified functions of the State Government under the National Dental Commission Act, 2023, within their respective jurisdictions. The Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) announced the decision through a notification issued under Article 239(1) of the Constitution.
articles.title_hi: राष्ट्रपति मुर्मू ने डेंटल कमीशन अधिनियम की शक्तियां यूटी प्रशासकों को सौंप दीं

articles.title: Manoj Kumar Jha Examines the Rise of Political Cruelty in India
articles.summary: Analyst Manoj Kumar Jha examines the erosion of constitutional morality and the normalisation of political cruelty in India using Alan Wolfe's theory of political evil. The essay highlights majoritarianism, punitive demolitions, institutional weakening, and the suffering of vulnerable populations. These alarming trends threaten foundational democratic principles by placing political convenience above the rule of law.
